Quelenna is a high-elven bandit who is looting the Overgrown Ruins in Act One.
“
Well, that's one less greedy bastard to share the loot with.
„
— Quelenna

Involvement

Act One

Quelenna is at the Chapel Entrance with  Gimblebock,  Taman, and  Warryn. She walks between a vantage point over the Chapel Entrance and occasionally down the stairs south of her. Quelenna carries  Talis: Divination without Magic, which suggests she may have an interest in Talis divination and a burgeoning relationship with a Talis diviner named Alys.

When approached by a party member, Gimblebock automatically engages them in conversation. Depending on the outcome of this conversation, Gimblebock and his crew either leave or attack the party. If one of Quelenna's crewmates dies, she is dismissive of the fatality, commenting that there is more loot to go around.
